data.name: Esmond
data.gender_notes: Esmond is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English Ēsmund, composed of Ēs (God) and mund (ruler or protector). The name was popular during the Middle Ages and was borne by various European rulers. The name Esmond carries the meaning “Ruler of the World” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Esmond usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine protection and rule in one's life.
data.etymology: Esmond belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the World.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Esmond total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Esmond
in_english.long_meaning: From the Old English word esmund meaning wealth, power, or might. It is derived from the elements ead meaning wealth, and mon meaning might or power. This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible.

data.cultural_impact: The name Esmond has enjoying a notable history in various European cultures. Medieval rulers such as Esmund De Beaurav. and Esmund Earl of Northumberland bore this name, contributing to its prominence in the Middle Ages. Through the ages, it has been embraced by royals, nobles, and common folk alike, leaving a lasting impression in many European communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Esmond carries a deep spiritual meaning as it represents 'God is my protector or ruler.' For those who bear this name, it's a constant reminder of divine guidance and God's ever-present watchful eye in our lives. Embracing the spiritual essence of this name can inspire a strong faith, deep trust in a higher power, and a sense of protection, fostering feelings of peace, security, and courage.
